description: getTransferStatus: Check the current status of a domain transfer. Requires authentication. Returns status, request date, current registrar, and expected completion.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name whose transfer to check, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getTransferStatus
